text:
anya: Heads-up: Launch post + webinar replay go live Wed 11am PT. Need SEO checklist: keywords, meta blurb, JSON-LD for teaser + gated video, internal link anchors from Resources, and redirects for last year's campaign. Who owns what?

jess: I can own meta + blog CTAs. Draft meta: "Production LLM benchmarks: how we cut inference latency 3x and lowered cost" (will trim).

tom: Keyword mapping + anchor text variations. Initial targets: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference latency optimization", and "enterprise LLM serving". Will add long-tail Qs.

mike: I'll do redirects. Legacy /webinar/latency-2025 -> /webinars/latency-2026. Plan: 302 preview -> 301 after 72h. nginx snippet: ```nginx
rewrite ^/webinar/latency-2025$ /webinars/latency-2026?utm_source=legacy_campaign redirect;
```

jess: Schema: teaser = Event JSON-LD; gated page = VideoObject + transcript (noindex). Tom, can you ensure internal links: /docs/inference-performance, /solutions/enterprise, /blog/ops?

tom: Yep, I'll add three anchors with varied anchor text and open PRs.

seo-bot: Reminder: run structured data validator and pre-index scan 24h before launch. Ticket MARKETING-SEO-478 created.

anya: Owners recap: Jess=meta+CTAs, Tom=keywords+anchors+PRs, Mike=redirects, seo-bot=pre-index checks. Deliverables due EOD Tue for infra QA. Thx! :rocket:
